patch_resolves_note: The authoritative fixed image no longer reaches the underflowed parameters parse on the original PoC: it emits only parameters_guard with last_byte1=7 and byte_index=8, then exits clean. The closest source-grounded perturbation seq1_len4_oid1 raises the inner sequence end just past the OID cursor, reaches parameters_parse genuinely with validation_span=1, and still exits clean.

root_cause_criterion.description: Before attempting to parse PKCS#8 parameters, the declared AlgorithmIdentifier end last_byte1 must still cover the current OID cursor byte_index so the unsigned span last_byte1 - byte_index cannot underflow.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: The vulnerable original emits parameters_guard last_byte1=7 byte_index=8 and still reaches parameters_parse, violating the missing guard. The fixed original emits the same unequal values but stays guarded, and the closest perturbation seq1_len4_oid1 supplies a genuine witness with last_byte1=11 byte_index=10 and parameters_parse executed cleanly.

nodes.description: The crash sink executes the one-byte type read bytes[0] with the caller-supplied remaining span passed into ptls_asn1_read_type.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original emits sink_read_type bytes_max=170371018 type_read_width=1 immediately before the saved ASan heap-buffer-overflow at ptls_asn1_read_type.

nodes.description: At the parameters parse call site, the unsigned span last_byte1 - byte_index has already wrapped far past the declared AlgorithmIdentifier end.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original emits parameters_parse parameter_offset=8 inner_seq_end=7 validation_span=18446744073709551615.

nodes.description: The first object parsed under the underflowed parameters span is constructed, so the recursive validator enters its child-descent loop.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original emits outer_object_length structure_bit=1 true_literal=1 while decoding the parameters object.

nodes.description: After the first nested child returns, the parent constructed-object loop still satisfies byte_index < last_byte and schedules the next recursive parse that reaches the sink.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original emits post_child_loop last_byte=170406547 next_offset=35529 next_span=170371018.

edges.description: The OID cursor byte_index observed at the missing-guard site is reused unchanged as the parameters parse offset.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original emits byte_index=8 at parameters_guard and parameter_offset=8 at parameters_parse; the genuine seq1_len4_oid1 witness preserves the same carry as 10 -> 10.

edges.description: The declared inner-sequence end last_byte1 observed at the missing-guard site is passed unchanged into the parameters span subtraction.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original emits last_byte1=7 at parameters_guard and inner_seq_end=7 at parameters_parse; the genuine witness preserves the same identity flow as 11 -> 11.

edges.description: The parameters span computed at the call site becomes the bytes_max bound for the first recursive ASN.1 validator frame.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original emits validation_span=18446744073709551615 at parameters_parse and outer_object_length bytes_max=18446744073709551615.

edges.description: The oversized last_byte derived from the forged outer length remains the parent loop bound after the first nested child returns.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original emits last_byte=170406547 at outer_object_length and again at post_child_loop.

edges.description: The parent loop’s remaining span last_byte - byte_index is passed unchanged into the next ptls_asn1_read_type call that crashes.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original emits post_child_loop next_span=170371018, and the very next sink_read_type event receives bytes_max=170371018.
